acceptance_predicates.description: Non-2xx, malformed, timeout, connection, and process failures become stable typed provider outcomes and preserve the failure through backend, CLI, human, and JSON layers.
An explicitly selected live run never silently falls back to a mock or cassette after a provider or transport failure.
Only provider/model/auth combinations present in the current connected compatibility snapshot are admitted; unavailable or stale discovery is typed and non-comparable.
Live development requests resolve curl through bounded trusted tool discovery rather than a fixed path or ambient PATH execution.
Missing development authentication, signatures, and key management remain visible warnings and never block local/mock qualification.
Diagnostics and receipts contain no API keys, raw provider responses, or private host paths.

definition_of_done: Focused negative and compatibility matrices pass at exact current ASB main.
Human-default and explicit --json contracts are verified.
Independent review and hosted checks pass without weakening gates.

inputs.description: Connected provider/model/auth catalog with generation and compatibility metadata.
Deterministic local HTTP and trusted-tool fixtures covering typed failures and success.

outputs.description: Stable provider outcome and remediation diagnostics for live and local paths.
Privacy-safe exact-head compatibility, error, and tool-discovery evidence.

gates.description: Every provider/transport failure remains typed through the public output boundary.
Curl discovery is bounded, identity-checked, and unavailable-tool behavior is explicit.
